env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: CUA processes raw pixel data to understand what’s happening on the screen and uses a virtual mouse and keyboard to complete actions.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Screenshots from the computer are added to the model’s context, providing a visual snapshot of the computer's current state.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: It performs the actions—clicking, scrolling, or typing—until it decides that the task is completed or user input is needed.
edit_primitive.note: Only mouse/keyboard action space described; no file edit primitive.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: CUA operates through an iterative loop that integrates perception, reasoning, and action

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: it can break tasks into multi-step plans and adaptively self-correct when challenges arise

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Powering Operator is Computer-Using Agent (CUA), a model that combines GPT‑4o's vision capabilities with advanced reasoning through reinforcement learning.
multi_agent_topology.note: A separate monitoring model exists but is a safety monitor, not a peer agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: CUA operates through an iterative loop that integrates perception, reasoning, and action

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The CUA model is trained to ask for user confirmation before finalizing tasks with external side effects, for example before submitting an order, sending an email, etc.
human_in_loop.note: Also 'Watch mode' requires active user supervision on sensitive websites.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: taking into consideration current and past screenshots and actions

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Screenshots from the computer are added to the model’s context, providing a visual snapshot of the computer's current state.

self_verification.evidence_quote: This inner monologue improves task performance by enabling the model to evaluate its observations, track intermediate steps, and adapt dynamically.
self_verification.note: Self-evaluation is in-model chain-of-thought, not a harness-run verifier.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: until it decides that the task is completed or user input is needed
termination_condition.note: max_steps from evaluation: 'CUA’s performance improves when more steps are allowed' with 'varying maximum allowed steps'.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: we are releasing CUA through a research preview of Operator at operator.chatgpt.com
execution_isolation.note: Operator runs a hosted remote browser; not explicitly described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Operator cannot access websites that we’ve preemptively blocked, such as many gambling sites, adult entertainment, and drug or gun retailers.
network_policy.note: Actually a blocklist; closest available value.

permission_model.evidence_quote: we’ve implemented an additional model to monitor and pause execution if it detects suspicious content on the screen
permission_model.note: Combined with per-call user confirmations for sensitive actions.

tracing.evidence_quote: User interactions are reviewed in real-time by automated safety checkers

eval_hooks.note: Closed product; no shipped evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The CUA model is trained to refuse many harmful tasks and illegal or regulated activities.
guardrails.note: Blocklist and monitor model pausing execution are action policies.

target_domain.evidence_quote: achieving a 38.1% success rate on OSWorld for full computer use tasks, and 58.1% on WebArena and 87% on WebVoyager for web-based tasks

open_source.evidence_quote: we are releasing CUA through a research preview of Operator at operator.chatgpt.com

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Powering Operator is Computer-Using Agent (CUA), a model that combines GPT‑4o's vision capabilities with advanced reasoning through reinforcement learning.

first_release_date.note: Date of the CUA/Operator research preview release post.

pinned_version.evidence_quote: Today we introduced a research preview of Operator⁠(opens in a new window), an agent that can go to the web to perform tasks for you.
pinned_version.note: No version tag or repo; pinned to the announcement date.
